Our research indicated that more than 90% of commercial floor space has flat or shallow pitch roofs; therefore, ComStock assumes flat roofs for modeling simplicity. For all states except California, ComStock models three roof types commonly seen in commercial construction: insulation entirely above deck (IEAD), metal building, and attic/other. In California, roof constructions are based on the DEER prototypes, and they include mass, wood-framed, and IEAD roofs. The roof construction assigned to a building is fixed based on the building type. More details can be found in the ComStock Reference Documentation [11]. As mentioned, because the EUL assumption for roofs is 200 years, the roofs in most buildings are assumed to be original.
